cases.name: json_parse_canonical
cases.sql: SELECT json_parse('{"b": 1.10, "a": [1e2, -0, "x"], "c": null}'), json_parse('[1, 2.5, true]'), json_parse('"text"')

cases.name: json_parse_invalid
cases.sql: SELECT json_parse('{a: 1}')

cases.name: json_format_fn
cases.sql: SELECT json_format(json_parse('{"b":1,"a":2}')), json_format(json_parse('[]'))

cases.name: json_extract_scalar_fn
cases.sql: SELECT json_extract_scalar('{"a": {"b": 1.10}, "s": "xç", "t": true, "n": null}', '$.a.b'), json_extract_scalar('{"s": "xç"}', '$.s'), json_extract_scalar('{"t": true}', '$.t'), json_extract_scalar('{"n": null}', '$.n'), json_extract_scalar('{"a": [1]}', '$.a')

cases.name: json_extract_bracket
cases.sql: SELECT json_extract_scalar('{"x.y": 5}', '$["x.y"]'), json_extract_scalar('[1, [2, 3]]', '$[1][0]')

cases.name: json_extract_invalid_doc
cases.sql: SELECT json_extract_scalar('not json', '$.a'), json_extract('{', '$')

cases.name: json_extract_bad_path
cases.sql: SELECT json_extract_scalar('{"a": 1}', 'a')

cases.name: json_array_fns
cases.sql: SELECT json_array_length('[1, 2, 3]'), json_array_length('{"a": 1}'), json_array_get('[1, [2], "x"]', 1), json_array_get('[1, 2]', -1), json_array_get('[1]', 5)

cases.name: json_array_contains_fn
cases.sql: SELECT json_array_contains('[1, 2, 3]', 2), json_array_contains('["a", "b"]', 'b'), json_array_contains('[true]', false), json_array_contains('[1.5]', 1.5E0), json_array_contains('{}', 1)

cases.name: is_json_scalar_fn
cases.sql: SELECT is_json_scalar('1'), is_json_scalar('"a"'), is_json_scalar('[1]'), is_json_scalar('{}')

cases.name: json_parse_null_edge
cases.sql: SELECT json_parse(CAST(NULL AS varchar)), json_parse('null'), json_parse('[]'), json_parse('{"a":{"b":[1,{"c":2}]}}')

cases.name: json_parse_numbers
cases.sql: SELECT json_parse('-0.0'), json_parse('12345678901234567890'), json_parse('1.0'), json_parse('1e2')

cases.name: json_format_null_edge
cases.sql: SELECT json_format(CAST(NULL AS json)), json_format(json_parse('"a\u00e7"')), json_format(json_parse('[1,"x",null]'))

cases.name: json_extract_null_edge
cases.sql: SELECT json_extract(CAST(NULL AS varchar), '$'), json_extract('{"a": null}', '$.a'), json_extract('[1,2,3]', '$[5]'), json_extract('{"a": {"b": 1}}', '$.a')

cases.name: json_extract_scalar_null
cases.sql: SELECT json_extract_scalar(CAST(NULL AS varchar), '$.a'), json_extract_scalar('{"a": [1]}', '$.a'), json_extract_scalar('{"a": 1e2}', '$.a'), json_extract_scalar('{"a": 12345678901234567890}', '$.a')

cases.name: json_array_null_edge
cases.sql: SELECT json_array_length(CAST(NULL AS varchar)), json_array_length('[]'), json_array_length('not json'), json_array_get(CAST(NULL AS varchar), 0), json_array_get('[]', 0), json_array_contains(CAST(NULL AS varchar), 1), json_array_contains('[1, "1"]', '1')

cases.name: json_array_json_type
cases.sql: SELECT json_array_length(json_parse('[1, [2, 3]]')), json_array_get(json_parse('["a", {"b": 1}]'), 1), json_array_contains(json_parse('[1.0]'), 1)

cases.name: json_size_null_edge
cases.sql: SELECT json_size(CAST(NULL AS varchar), '$'), json_size('[]', '$'), json_size('not json', '$')

cases.name: is_json_scalar_null_edge
cases.sql: SELECT is_json_scalar(CAST(NULL AS varchar)), is_json_scalar('null'), is_json_scalar(json_parse('true'))

cases.name: is_json_scalar_invalid
cases.sql: SELECT is_json_scalar('{a')

cases.name: json_cast_to_json
cases.sql: SELECT CAST(ARRAY[1, 2] AS json), CAST(MAP(ARRAY['b', 'a'], ARRAY[1, 2]) AS json), CAST('x' AS json), CAST(1.5E0 AS json), CAST(true AS json), CAST(CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS json)

cases.name: json_cast_from_json
cases.sql: SELECT CAST(json_parse('[1, 2]') AS array(bigint)), CAST(json_parse('{"a": 1}') AS map(varchar, bigint)), CAST(json_parse('"x"') AS varchar), CAST(json_parse('12') AS bigint), CAST(json_parse('true') AS boolean)

cases.name: json_cast_from_json_invalid
cases.sql: SELECT CAST(json_parse('"x"') AS bigint)

cases.name: json_literal
cases.sql: SELECT JSON '{"a": 1}', json_extract_scalar(JSON '{"a": 1}', '$.a')

cases.name: json_cast_to_json_more
cases.sql: SELECT CAST(DATE '2024-01-02' AS json), CAST(DECIMAL '1.50' AS json), CAST(ARRAY[1, NULL] AS json), CAST(REAL '1.1' AS json), CAST(ARRAY[ARRAY['a'], NULL] AS json), CAST(CAST(7 AS bigint) AS json)

cases.name: json_cast_row_to_json
cases.sql: SELECT CAST(ROW(1, 'a') AS json), CAST(CAST(ROW(1, 'a') AS row(x integer, y varchar)) AS json)

cases.name: json_cast_map_to_json
cases.sql: SELECT CAST(MAP(ARRAY[2, 1], ARRAY['b', 'a']) AS json), CAST(MAP(ARRAY['k'], ARRAY[ARRAY[1.5E0]]) AS json)

cases.name: json_cast_to_varchar
cases.sql: SELECT CAST(json_parse('"abc"') AS varchar), CAST(json_parse('1.5') AS varchar), CAST(json_parse('12') AS varchar), CAST(json_parse('true') AS varchar), CAST(json_parse('null') AS varchar)

cases.name: json_cast_extract_to_varchar
cases.sql: SELECT CAST(json_extract('{"a": "x", "b": 2}', '$.a') AS varchar), CAST(json_extract('{"a": "x", "b": 2}', '$.b') AS varchar), json_extract_scalar('{"a": "x"}', '$.a')

cases.name: json_cast_to_numbers
cases.sql: SELECT CAST(json_parse('1.5') AS bigint), CAST(json_parse('"12"') AS integer), CAST(json_parse('true') AS bigint), CAST(json_parse('2') AS double), CAST(json_parse('"1.25"') AS double), CAST(json_parse('1.255') AS decimal(4,2))

cases.name: json_cast_to_boolean
cases.sql: SELECT CAST(json_parse('0') AS boolean), CAST(json_parse('1.5') AS boolean), CAST(json_parse('"true"') AS boolean), CAST(json_parse('false') AS boolean)

cases.name: json_cast_to_containers
cases.sql: SELECT CAST(json_parse('[1, null, 3]') AS array(integer)), CAST(json_parse('{"b": [1], "a": []}') AS map(varchar, array(bigint))), CAST(json_parse('["a", 1, true]') AS array(varchar)), CAST(json_parse('null') AS array(bigint))

cases.name: json_cast_to_row
cases.sql: SELECT CAST(json_parse('[1, "x"]') AS row(a integer, b varchar)), CAST(json_parse('{"b": "y", "a": 2}') AS row(a integer, b varchar))
